name: What are the most common mistakes in small ADU kitchen construction?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes cause the biggest regrets after a small ADU kitchen is finished?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes cause the biggest regrets after a small ADU kitchen is finished?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small ADU kitchens fail most often when the design tries to copy a standard home kitchen without adjusting for the smaller footprint. Common mistakes include oversized appliances, too many upper cabinets, poor traffic flow, weak ventilation, and not leaving enough landing space next to the sink or cooktop. Another frequent problem is waiting too long to decide on appliances, which can force late changes to cabinet dimensions or utility rough-ins. In garage conversions and detached ADUs, hidden infrastructure issues can also create major headaches if they are not solved before finishes begin. The best small kitchens are efficient, simple, and well coordinated. They use the right appliance sizes, storage solutions, and lighting to make the space feel larger than it is. Homeowners who want a good result should focus on function first and aesthetics second, then make the aesthetics support the function. That approach prevents the small kitchen from becoming the most frustrating room in the ADU.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistakes are overcrowded layouts, undersized storage, weak ventilation, poor appliance planning, and failing to coordinate plumbing or electrical early. Many problems come from treating the kitchen like a miniature house kitchen instead of designing it specifically for a compact ADU footprint.
